usedFor: Prospects noted as Roma list items become deals in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New Item” in Roma, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Roma pushes “New Item” when one is added, so the prospect reaches HubSpot without retyping.

watchOut: “Updated Item” and “Deleted Item” can run “Create Deal” too, so edits or deletions would create deals.
